title: AFRICOM Strikes Near Qumbi and Sablaale, Danab Ground Raid Kills 7 Including Senior Commander — 74th US Strike of 2026
detail: AFRICOM struck Al-Shabaab positions near Qumbi (roughly 88km northwest of Kismayo) and separately near Sablaale (roughly 190km southwest of Mogadishu) in Lower Shabelle. The same night, Danab Commandos conducted a ground raid in Sablaale district, killing 7 Al-Shabaab fighters including a senior commander and destroying two training and propaganda facilities. Reporting placed this as the 74th US airstrike in Somalia in 2026, on pace to exceed 2025's record of roughly 124-126 strikes.

media.caption: Antiwar.com (Jul 14, 2026): US bombs Somalia for 74th time this year

title: SNA and International Partner Airstrikes Kill 26 Al-Shabaab Militants in Middle Shabelle
detail: Somali security forces, 'in collaboration with international partners,' struck Al-Shabaab positions in the Adow Jilib, Gayfo and Qordheere areas of Middle Shabelle region, killing 26 militants and destroying one armored vehicle and one fuel tanker, according to Somali military statements. The strikes were part of the same week's intensified operational tempo across Lower and Middle Shabelle.

media.caption: FTL Somalia (Jul 13, 2026): Military operations target Al-Shabaab strongholds in Gayfo, Ruun Idiris and Qordheere
